page: Microsoft Azure M48bds_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual machine from the MBDSMediumMemoryv3 family, powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8473C processor. This x86_64 architecture server features 48 vCPUs derived from 24 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, running at a clock speed of 4.0 GHz. It is equipped with 384.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. The system includes a 410 GB local SSD and is premium storage capable, though it does not feature any GPUs.

Benchmark results indicate strong capabilities across multiple domains. The server achieves top-tier performance in image processing and strong performance in Geekbench single-core and multi-core tests, software compilation, and ray tracing. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient, scoring in the top 25% for both cached small-block and uncached large-block read and write operations. Cryptographic and vector calculations are accelerated by hardware flags such as AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions.

Given its high memory density and strong database operations benchmark, the M48bds_v3 is well-suited for memory-intensive workloads, database management, and large-scale text or image processing. It also demonstrates strong performance in medium-sized language model inference. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and high memory-per-vCPU ratio offer a balanced resource profile for enterprise applications requiring substantial RAM without the overhead of GPU accelerators.
